title.en: Apollo announces a scoped embedded evaluation pilot at OpenAI
title.zhHans: Apollo 宣布在 OpenAI 开展受限嵌入式评估试点

searchSummary.en: Apollo announced a scoped four-month embedded-assessment pilot with six researchers; OpenAI separately named Apollo, METR, Transluce and Goodfire as collaborators.
searchSummary.zhHans: Apollo 宣布由六人团队开展为期四个月、范围受限的嵌入式评估试点；OpenAI 另行点名 Apollo、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 为合作方。

summary.en: On November 16, Apollo Research announced a scoped four-month embedded-assessment pilot with a six-person team at OpenAI. In a public post the same day, OpenAI named Apollo, METR, Transluce and Goodfire as embedded-assessment collaborators. Neither announcement establishes that every pilot had started or yielded independent findings.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 16 日，Apollo Research 宣布将由六人团队在 OpenAI 开展为期四个月、范围受限的嵌入式评估试点。OpenAI 同日公开帖子点名 Apollo、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 为嵌入式评估合作方。这些公告不证明所有试点都已启动，或已产出独立调查结果。

narrative.en: Apollo describes negotiated access and publication conditions for its own pilot, not unrestricted employee-level access. The OpenAI post identifies four collaborators but does not verify their individual schedules, completed assessments, or the efficacy of OpenAI safeguards. The public post does not specify the other collaborators’ schedules or terms; Apollo’s four-month, six-person terms apply only to Apollo.
narrative.zhHans: Apollo 说明的是本机构试点协商确定的访问和发表条件，而非不受限制的员工级访问。OpenAI 帖子确认四家合作方名称，但不证明各机构的具体日程、评估已完成或 OpenAI 防护措施有效。公开帖子没有说明其他合作方的日程或条款；Apollo 的四个月、六人安排只适用于 Apollo。

text.en: On November 16, Apollo announced an embedded evaluation pilot at OpenAI involving six researchers over four months, with scoped access conditions.
text.zhHans: 11 月 16 日，Apollo 宣布在 OpenAI 开展一项嵌入式评估试点，由六人团队进行四个月，并设有访问范围限制。

claims.notes: Apollo first-party announcement; states its pilot arrangement, not an accomplished four-month result.

text.en: OpenAI named Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire among its embedded-assessment collaborators in a November 16 public post.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 在 11 月 16 日的公开帖子中将 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 列为嵌入式评估合作方。

claims.notes: One directly captured first-party public post naming four; truncation prevents inferring all terms or starts. Other three partners spoke independently in separate captured materials but are not used to claim independent verification of outcomes.
